user_request: Show some UI ideas for this game. Great modern ideas, nothing plain, old or generic AI-generated-looking.
deliverable: Three distinct complementary landscape static UI design proposals: camp HUD, storage/upgrade, survivor/assignment. These are visual ideas, not a running game or three complete interchangeable UI systems.
orientation: Landscape exploration grounded in the inspected native 1920x1080 viewport; no permanent orientation change is approved.
visual_direction: Premium deliberate graphic design with strong type hierarchy, crisp readable copy, generous but purposeful spacing and meaningful icons.
Approved rounded stylized3D Havenline winter assets: blue/orange, brown leather/timber, cream trim and sculpted snow.
Three visibly distinct screen treatments: airy world-led HUD, bright editorial storage, dramatic midnight survivor profile.
No generic fantasy gold borders, ornamental medieval UI, tiny illegible pseudo-text, neon sci-fi glass dashboard, repeated empty rounded-card filler or excessive badges.
functional_visual_requirements: Camp HUD: playable center remains clear; one movement joystick; restrained contextual action and management navigation; no manual attack-button clutter.

Illustrated camp: compact fenced footprint, centered stone furnace, at least two distinct visibly open passages, snow outside with no painted external roads, consistent approved character proportions.
Storage: recognizable approved house, logical upgrade preview/current-next distinction, clear inventory and one upgrade action; all displayed values illustrative.
Survivor: current Character1 compact proportions, black glasses fronts with white arms, blue-orange coat, brown belt/right-hip pouch; natural idle pose, clear assignment/primary action.
Each UI screen has readable navigation, a clear primary action, coherent sample values and no control/text collisions.
Native full-image and representative landscape-phone-size visual checks by a separate critic; pass at least9.5, target9.9, with every mandatory check passed.
evidence_and_storage: Preserve all original images and repair versions, exact prompts, actual ordered reference inputs and hashes.
Save selected images, source mappings, design rationale, independent reviews and gallery directly to an additive GitHub art branch.
Preserve every baseline file and mode at30f4f037baf54b24652360c8b6880771e29cc19a; do not touch active Codex/runtime/main/workflows.

scope_limits: New visual UI proposals with illustrative text/state values; not approved game economy, abilities, implementation or character-role canon.
New camp illustration is not a live gameplay screenshot or verified native camp placement.
Static images cannot establish touch target behavior, performance, animation or runtime accessibility.
